hypothesis: After M159 clears the current zero-relvel matched-history action blocker, the M156 s20 candidate must still pass the remaining M154 outcome and strict proof-surface stages before any PPO continuation.
success_criteria: use the M156 s20 checkpoint and current P0 zero-relvel actor input contract
run matched-history outcome intervention on the M159 current surface
clear wrong-history outcome thresholds: mean margin gap at least 0.005, at least 6 success-drop pairs, and at least 6 selected physical pairs
run strict proof-surface gates at seeds 9900 and 9920
meet strict proof-surface selected-pair and selected-seed thresholds for both seeds
state explicitly whether guarded PPO continuation is admitted or rejected
failure_criteria: start PPO before outcome and strict proof-surface gates pass
reuse the old M118 surface for current zero-relvel outcome claims
claim driver promotion from M154; M154 can only admit guarded PPO
ignore the M159 top-80 negative calibration when choosing the action/outcome surface
